title: Bind and test cleanup-beads-migration against the Phoenix root
outcome: The cleanup script operates only on the Phoenix checkout containing the script and is safe, idempotent, and explicit about its PowerShell version.
acceptance: Focused tests cover legacy, custom, unset, idempotent, and wrong-CWD cases, and the script declares or safely supports its minimum PowerShell version
Legacy Phoenix hooksPath removal, an unset hooksPath, and a second run all exit successfully under the supported PowerShell native-command error behavior
The expected repository root is derived from PSScriptRoot, verified against the Phoenix Engram marker, and passed to git with an explicit -C
Wrong-CWD execution cannot unset another repository's hooksPath; custom hooks paths remain unchanged
